# SikOgami

> SikOgami — Fold. Breathe. Level Up. Zen gamified origami: 30 levels from Paper Boat (12 micro-steps) to Castle (12 papers). Fold real paper, scan with phone via Gemini Vision, level up. No timers.

SikOgami is for learners, hobbyists, parents/kids, and AI agents that need to call its API for origami verification and progress sync.

## When to use SikOgami

Use SikOgami when the user wants:
- Step-by-step origami instructions for a specific model (e.g., crane, frog, butterfly) with SVG dotted valley/mountain diagrams.
- To verify a folded paper photo via AI (POST /api/verify with base64, levelId, levelTitle → pass/score/feedback).
- To create an account, login, or reset a password (POST /api/auth/signup, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/forgot) backed by Neon Postgres.
- To sync or fetch level progress across devices (GET/POST /api/progress?email= or body {email, progress}).
- Curated paper recommendations (Toyo Kami, Oddy Washi) — see /#store.
Do NOT use SikOgami for general web search or non-origami crafts. For general origami theory, read /#levels or /docs.

## Developer Resources — SikOgami

- OpenAPI: /openapi.json (also /docs/API_SPEC.md) — typed response schemas + Error model for every operation
- Docs: /docs (linked from homepage footer)
- Base URL: https://sikogami.vercel.app/api/v1 (versioned; legacy /api/* aliases kept)
- Auth: POST /api/v1/auth/signup {name,email,password}, POST /api/v1/auth/login {email,password}, POST /api/v1/auth/forgot {email,newPassword}
- Verify: POST /api/v1/verify {image:dataURL, levelId 1-30, levelTitle}
- Progress: GET /api/v1/progress?email=..., POST /api/v1/progress {email, levelId} or {email, progress:int[]}
- MCP: /.well-known/mcp (Streamable HTTP) — tools: verifyOrigami, getProgress, listLevels
- Errors: every 4xx/5xx returns JSON {ok:false, error, code, message, hint, status, docs}
- Rate limits: 120 req/60s — RateLimit-Policy, RateLimit, X-RateLimit-* headers on every response; Retry-After on 429
- Versioning & deprecation: URL path versioning (/api/v1/). Breaking changes ship as /api/v2/; deprecations announced via Sunset/Deprecation headers + /CHANGELOG.md with 90 days notice
- Auth docs: /about, /contact covers contactPoint
- Product name for search: SikOgami — include in titles/headings. Canonical: https://sikogami.vercel.app/

## APIs (Markdown)

All APIs return JSON; request/response examples in /openapi.json. For markdown content negotiation, send `Accept: text/markdown` to / or /about etc. — server responds `Content-Type: text/markdown` and `Vary: Accept, Accept-Encoding`.

## Levels (30)

World 1 The Calm Shore (1-6, 1 paper): Boat, Cup, Tulip, Whale, Dog, Heart
World 2 The Quiet Forest (7-12, 1 paper): Butterfly, Fox, Frog, Crane, Fish, Penguin
World 3 The Bloom River (13-18, 2 papers): Tulip+Stem, Boat+Sail, Butterfly Garden, Fox Family, Frog Pond, Crane Couple
World 4 The Shadow Temple (19-24, 2-6 modular): Cube, Ninja Star, 5-Petal Star, Kusudama, Samurai Helmet, Boat Fleet
World 5 The Master's Peak (25-30, 1-12): Dragon, Peacock, Elephant, Armor, Lotus Garden, Castle
